title: feat(types)!: SidebarSchema declares what the sidebar node draws; nine unread keys retire, variant takes the registration's enum (objectui#11465)
body:
Fixes #11465
Clause-②: yes

Dev run for objectui#11465 under the `domain:spec` seat's claim (comment `5955764801`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`. It executes triage's key-by-key direction (comment `5954161531`): retire the nine keys the `sidebar` node never draws, give `variant` the renderer's enum, and move the types README example to children composition. `collapsible` was settled by PR objectui#11463 and is untouched.

Note on spelling: GitHub strips tag-shaped text from bodies, so generic parameters and placeholders below are written as words.

## The accept-set change, key by key

| Key | Both faces before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `title` | `string` | refused by name: compose a heading `text` node at the start of `children` |
| `nav` | a NavLink array | refused by name: navigation is app metadata (the app's `navigation`, objectui#11441), or compose items as `children` |
| `content` | a node or a node list | refused by name: move the node(s) into `children` |
| `footer` | a node or a node list | refused by name: the last entries of `children` |
| `position` | `left` or `right` | refused by name: delete the key |
| `defaultCollapsed` | boolean | refused by name: delete the key (the sidebar provider owns the open state) |
| `collapsed` | boolean | refused by name: delete the key |
| `width` | string or number | refused by name: delete the key; the in-flow form takes a `className` width utility such as `w-72` |
| `collapsedWidth` | string or number | refused by name: delete the key (the node never collapses to a narrower width) |
| `variant` | `default`, `bordered`, `floating` | `sidebar`, `floating`, `inset` (the registration's enum); `default` and `bordered` refused with `invalid_value` and a message that says to write `sidebar` |

- **TypeScript face** (`packages/types/src/navigation.ts`): each retired key is a `?: never` tombstone with a RETIRED docblock, so `tsc` refuses it by name. `variant` is the three-value union with `@default 'sidebar'`.
- **zod face** (`packages/types/src/zod/navigation.zod.ts`): each retired key is a `retirementTombstone` built by a local `retiredSidebarKey(key, why, instead)`, whose message reads `RETIRED (objectui#11465, ADR-0049) — KEY on sidebar had no reader: WHY Instead: INSTEAD`. `variant` is `z.enum(['sidebar', 'floating', 'inset'], { error })`.
- **Widening:** `variant: 'sidebar'` and `variant: 'inset'` were refused (`invalid_value` at `variant`) on both faces before this change, measured; both validate now. **Narrowing:** the nine keys, and `variant: 'default'` / `'bordered'`, which validated on both faces before, measured.
- The renderer is unchanged. Its registration already offered `sidebar` / `floating` / `inset`, and shadcn's `Sidebar` reads `variant` off the spread.

## Zone 2 readings, measured before building

**H1 — which keys the renderer reads after PR objectui#11463.** `SidebarNode` reads `schema.children` and destructures `collapsible`; everything else goes through its rest spread onto shadcn's `Sidebar`, which destructures `side`, `variant`, `collapsible`, `className`, `children` and spreads the remainder onto the panel element. A one-off runtime probe (real `SchemaRenderer`, real registry, bare host at desktop width, both `collapsible` forms, one key at a time against its absence; not committed) read:

- `title: 'ZZTITLE'` landed as an HTML `title` attribute on the panel element, a native hover tooltip, never a heading;
- `nav`, `content`, `footer` landed as attributes whose value is the string `[object Object]`;
- `position`, `width` landed as inert attributes; `collapsedWidth` as a lowercase `collapsedwidth` attribute, with React's unknown-prop warning;
- `defaultCollapsed`, `collapsed`: markup byte-identical to absence, React warned and dropped them;
- controls in the same probe: `side: 'right'` moved the panel to the right edge, and `className: 'w-72'` replaced the width class, so the probe could see a change when one happened.

No key on the retire list is read, so all nine retire. ⚠️ `title` is the one whose spread had a user-visible effect (the tooltip). I read that as the rest-spread DOM leak, the same channel that writes `nav="[object Object]"`, not as the node honouring "Sidebar title"; it is flagged in the report for the contract review.

**H2 — the retirement convention.** Followed the in-repo precedent: `retirementTombstone()` on the zod face plus `?: never` on the TypeScript face (objectui#11434 PR 1, objectui#10387). For the two retired enum values the precedent is an enum with a named `error` (`object-data-table`'s `drillDown.target`, objectui#10685). ⛔ No bare deletion: `BaseSchema`'s index signature would type it `any`, and `.passthrough()` would let it parse green.

**H3 — does `variant` reach shadcn as authored.** Yes, through the real `SchemaRenderer`. On the collapsible form, `sidebar` draws exactly what an absent `variant` draws; `floating` and `inset` each draw differently (padded panel; `floating`'s inner panel takes the rounded, bordered, shadowed classes through `data-variant`). `default` and `bordered` changed only `data-variant`; their classes were `sidebar`'s. On the in-flow form (`collapsible: false`) every value, the three included, draws byte-identical markup: shadcn's not-collapsible branch ignores `variant`. The renderer is not changed. The behaviour is stated in the describe text, the TypeScript doc and the changeset, and pinned (below).

**H4 — corpus authors of a retired key or value.** Swept every tracked file for an authored `sidebar` node (`type: 'sidebar'`, the JSON spelling, and `ui:sidebar`) across `examples/**`, `content/docs/**`, every README, every package's tests and fixtures, the designer palettes, and the objectstack checkout. Each hit re-judged:

| Document | Authored | Disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/README.md`, "4. Composable" | `nav` | rewritten to children composition (`collapsible: false`, a `text` and a `button` child): the ruling |
| `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts` | `nav` (three links) | the three links become three ghost `button` children; `collapsible: true` kept as authored |
| `content/docs/components/basic/sidebar.mdx` and the four `components-basic-sidebar` catalog documents | `collapsible`, `className`, `children` | no change |
| `content/docs/components/navigation/header-bar.mdx` | a bare `sidebar` placeholder | no change |
| tests (`sidebar-node-provider-10859`, the app-shell one-provider pin, `widget-dom-leak-sweep`, `container-declaration-ratchet`, the cli ratchet) | no retired key | no change |
| objectstack | its `type: 'sidebar'` hits are app `navigation` shapes, not this node | no change |

No document anywhere authors `variant` on a `sidebar` node.

## Pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/sidebar-declared-surface-11465.test.ts`
  - type level (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): each retired key reads as `undefined` on both faces; `variant` is exactly the three values on both faces; `collapsible` keeps its boolean (non-vacuity); a `@ts-expect-error` per retired key and per retired value.
  - runtime: each retired key, for every former arm, is refused at its own path on the strict face, the tolerant face and the mirror; the message starts with the RETIRED prefix and carries `Instead:` and its prescription; lit controls (the same node without the key parses everywhere; an undeclared key stays green on the tolerant face).
  - `variant`: the three validate on both faces; `default` and `bordered` are refused at `variant` with `invalid_value`.
  - README leg: the `sidebar` literal of the README's "4. Composable" fence is extracted and evaluated, never retyped, and validates on both faces; control: the example the README taught before is refused at `nav`.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/sidebar-variant-registration-11465.test.tsx`: reads the live registration's `variant` enum; every value it offers validates on both faces, and the two retired values are refused; through the real `SchemaRenderer`, the offered values draw pairwise-different markup on the collapsible form, and identical markup on the in-flow form.
- The README snippet type-checks: `pnpm check:doc-snippets` compiles the fence against the built `dist`.

**Ledger moves:**
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: the arm-count non-vacuity control moves from `SidebarSchema.content` (now a one-arm tombstone) to `SidebarSchema.children`, the channel the node reads. The `NavLinkSchema` row leaves `RECURSION_BREAKING_MIRRORS`: its no-dead-entries case went red naming it, because `SidebarSchema.nav` was the only registered slot that reached it. `NavLink` and `NavLinkSchema` stay exported.
- `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`: the new test is adjudicated as a reader of `packages/types/README.md` (its `--audit` named it as unadjudicated).

## Gates — all at `c95b819e`

| Gate | Verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (all three legs; the new test and `examples/dashboard.ts` confirmed in the programs with `--listFilesOnly`) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (the new test confirmed in the program) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` | 334 files, 8814 tests passed |
| consumer radius: the two new pins, `sidebar-node-provider-10859`, `container-declaration-ratchet`, schema-catalog `sidebar-node-docs-10859` / `safe-validate-corpus-6318` / `component-fixture-declared-keys` / `catalog-gallery-render`, the cli ratchet, the layout one-provider pin, `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` | 10 files, 733 tests passed |
| `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (closure built with its own `--build-filter`) | 776 of 776 blocks judged, 0 failed |
| `pnpm check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:readme-exports` | exit 0 each |
| `check-changeset-no-major`, `-presence`, `-fixed`, `-overwrite`; `check:changeset-claims` (report-only: 18 pending changesets name a touched file; each read, none is falsified by this diff) | exit 0 each |
| `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes` | exit 0 each |
| `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only) | the nine `ui:sidebar` interface-extra-key rows leave the census; `read-of-tombstoned-key` stays 0 |
| `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-prompt-component-keys`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:published-dist`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check-lint-coverage`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit` | exit 0 each |
| `check:sdui-registration-pins` | NOT MEASURED: exit 2, no console build to weigh; this diff moves no registration input, so it is not owed here |

**Lint, narrowed and declared.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the seven changed lintable files: 7 files, 0 errors (2 warnings, both on unchanged `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` lines whose inline disable `--no-inline-config` ignores). The `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block of `eslint.config.js` covers six of them and the `.mjs` is covered too; the config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full test farm are CI's.

## Ablation and reverse verification

Each leg ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on the committed tree: the mutation proven on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed), the restore proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). vitest resolves `@object-ui/types` to source through the root alias, so the vitest legs need no rebuild.

1. zod `variant` enum back to `default` / `bordered` / `floating`: 7 failed (four in the types pin, three in the components pin).
2. zod `title` accepting a string again: 2 failed (the refusal-path and message cases for `title`).
3. TypeScript `title?: string` again: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` red with TS2344 (the `Equal` row), TS2578 (the unused `@ts-expect-error`) and TS2322 in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`'s drift ledger.
4. The README's old `nav` line put back into the fence: `pnpm check:doc-snippets` judged 1 block failed, TS2322 at the README's `nav` line (a NavLink-shaped array is not assignable to `undefined`), which proves the gate read the rebuilt `.d.ts`. The first attempt was a no-op (my anchor was a prefix of its replacement, and the tool refused to count it as landed); it was re-run with a non-prefix anchor.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **`side`:** the registration offers `side` (`left` / `right`) and shadcn honours it, but `SidebarSchema` does not declare it, so the strict face refuses `side: 'right'` (`unrecognized_keys`) while the render honours it. `check:component-surface-parity` already reports it (`ui:sidebar.side`, input-outside-keyset). The `position` tombstone deliberately does not point at `side`.
- **`variant` on the in-flow form** draws nothing (H3); not changed, by the ruling.
- **`NavLink` / `NavLinkSchema`** stay exported but no longer type any declared member; whether they retire too is an open question in the report, outside the claimed file surface.
- **The rest spread:** `SidebarNode` forwards every unread key onto the panel element, which is how `[object Object]` attributes arose. After this change the validator refuses the nine; the renderer is untouched (⛔ no consumer-side narrowing).
- `content/docs/components/basic/sidebar.mdx` does not document `variant`; its sentence on what the renderer reads is not made false by this change, and it is outside the claimed surface.
- **Overlap:** `main` was merged at `2c0ddf226` (PR objectui#11477 edits other blocks of the types README and the imports of `examples/dashboard.ts`); this diff's hunks there are the `sidebar` literals only.
